spec.name: Synthetic 50 mm singlet: bounded refocus demonstration

limits: Sequential centered spherical refractive systems; angle fields; mm; EPD.
Geometric centroid RMS spot and scalar FFT MTF are distinct metrics.
A sparse pupil ray check detects gross failures; it is not a full vignetting analysis.

yield.interval_scope: completed independent Monte Carlo trials; analysis failures count as failures; no compensation

random_engine: Python random.Random MT19937; independent uniform or Gaussian draws
